title: Maxeon Solar Panels: The Most Reliable Technology in Solar
summary: Among the numerous solar panel options available on the market today, Maxeon’s flagship interdigitated back contact (IBC) solar panels stand above the rest for their proven performance, reliability, and long-term financial returns.
body_markdown:
In an era where demand for energy is increasing, solar power has rapidly gained traction as a reliable, cost-effective solution. Among the numerous solar panel options available on the market today, Maxeon’s flagship[interdigitated back contact (IBC) solar panels](https://www.maxeon.com/maxeon-solar-panels) stand above the rest for their proven performance, reliability, and long-term financial returns.


### **More Power, More Reliably, For Longer**


Maxeon’s patented back contact cell design and module construction ensure that its solar panels outperform others in energy production over the long haul. Here’s how:


1.


[Production in Low Light and Shade](https://www.maxeon.com/maxeon-blog/shade-happens) **:** Maxeon panels are engineered to capture more sunlight during low-light conditions—early mornings, cloudy afternoons, and evenings—maximizing energy output throughout the day. And unlike many conventional panels, Maxeon’s optimized electrical design ensures cells maintain a safe temperature in shade, mitigating the risk of long-term panel damage from hotspots.


2.


[Resistance to Hail](https://www.maxeon.com/maxeon-blog/how-maxeon-solar-panels-beat-the-growing-threat-of-hailstorms) **:** Maxeon panels are IEC-certified to withstand hailstones up to 45 mm in diameter thanks to a robust protective frame and tempered glass that outperform many competing panels.


3.


[Durability in Extreme Weather](https://www.maxeon.com/maxeon-blog/category/Extreme+Weather) : Maxeon’s patented cell design with thick cell connectors endure high heat, extreme cold, and temperature fluctuations without compromising performance.


4.


**Industry-Leading Longevity** : Thanks to the lowest degradation rate in the industry, Maxeon panels retain their power advantage for up to 40 years. This means more energy production from day one and sustained performance for decades to come.


[Maxeon panels are significantly less likely to develop hot spots](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/hotspots)


Shaded Maxeon cells demonstrate lower heat generation, that is more evenly spread across the entire cell. As such, the diodes in Maxeon panels activate less frequently, increasing both energy production and useful life of the panel.


When an area of a standard solar panel, due to shading for example, can no longer produce enough current to match its neighboring cells, the cells begin consuming power from the surrounding cells and converting it to heat. While bypass diodes are used to prevent overheating, persistent activation can cause the diodes to fail which makes the panel susceptible to hotspot formation. Shaded Maxeon cells demonstrate lower heat generation, that is more evenly spread across the entire cell. As such, the diodes in Maxeon panels activate less frequently, increasing both energy production and useful life of the panel.


[Read more →](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/hotspots)


[Maxeon panels are built to power through temperature swings](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/temp-swings)


Maxeon solar panels feature thick, plated copper contacts for long-term stability. Each tab offers redundant connections with built in strain relief, to ensure a consistent flow of energy while having the flexibility to expand and contract with temperature changes.


As the ambient temperature heats and cools on a daily basis, the metallic ribbons used in standard solar cell connections expand and contract with the temperature change. This repetitive contraction and expansion causes the metal connections to degrade and break over time. Maxeon panels on the other hand feature thick, plated copper contacts for long-term stability. Each tab offers redundant connections with built in strain relief, to ensure a consistent flow of energy while having the flexibility to expand and contract with temperature changes.


[Read more →](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/temp-swings)


[Maxeon panels are built to power through heat and humidity](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/heat-humidity)


The unique design of Maxeon panels not only features an engineered encapsulant that is highly resistive to moisture, but thick, plated copper which is much more robust and able to better withstand corrosion.


A solar panel’s encapsulant plays a critical role in protecting against humidity and moisture-induced corrosion. In humid conditions, moisture can penetrate through the layers of standard solar panels, corroding the panel’s thin metallic electrical connections. The unique design of Maxeon panels not only features an engineered encapsulant that is highly resistive to moisture, but thick, plated copper which is much more robust and able to better withstand corrosion.


[Read more →](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/heat-humidity)


[Maxeon panels perform more reliably in shade](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/shading)


It takes just a little bit of shade to impact the power output of a solar panel. Standard solar panels typically activate bypass diodes to counter the obstruction—shutting down an entire section of the panel to mitigate heat build-up—sacrificing energy generation in the process. Maxeon panels offer greater resilience to shade, powering through small obstructions with only a slight reduction in power output.


[Read more →](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/shading)


[Maxeon solar panels deliver extreme crack resistance](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/cracks)


Cracked cells in standard panels can occur from transport, installation, environmental stresses, and even poor manufacturing quality. Maxeon cells are reinforced by a thick plated layer of metal for added structural strength. If a crack forms, the metal backing holds the cell in place while maintaining full electrical conductivity.


[Read more →](https://www.maxeon.com/videos/v/cracks)


### **Third-Party Validation**


Maxeon IBC panels have been regularly recognized as a[Top Performer in the Kiwa PVEL PV Module Reliability Scorecard](https://scorecard.pvel.com/top-performers/) .​ The annual Scorecard provides insights about the long-term reliability and performance of solar panels, identifying industry Top Performers in critical reliability tests including thermal cycling, damp heat, mechanical stress, and hail stress, among others.


### **The Best Warranty in Solar**


Maxeon stands apart from others with its[comprehensive 40-year warranty](https://www.maxeon.com/warranty) . This industry-first coverage includes power, product, and service provisions for complete peace of mind. Key features include:


1.


**Longer product protection** : With an impressive track record of reliability, Maxeon panels are supported by a 40-year warranty on workmanship and materials – 10 to 15 years longer than most solar panels.


2.


**Transferable Coverage** : Even when replacing your roof or selling your home, the warranty provides continuous protection.


3.


**Guaranteed Power Output** : Maxeon offers leading warranted power output protection—88.3% of the original power rating at year 40.


### **An Aesthetic Advantage**


In addition to peak performance, Maxeon panels look better than anything else on the market. The sleek, all-black design integrates seamlessly with any roof—offering a stylish and unobtrusive energy solution for homeowners. Furthermore, since Maxeon panels produce more energy in less space, system owners can maximize their energy output without compromising on design.

By choosing a Maxeon Preferred Partner, you can trust you’re getting the best product installed by an experienced solar expert.

Maxeon has a long-standing reputation for quality and reliability, and testing by third parties consistently ranks our high efficiency solar panels at or near the top of the field for both performance and durability. And feedback from partners and installers globally confirms that Maxeon has one of the industry's lowest return rates, a testament to the quality of our products. As global demand for energy grows exponentially, millions are choosing Maxeon to generate clean energy at the highest value.
